body:
CHIEF ON THE POST-MERGE API DISCLOSURE: THE MERGE STANDS, THE DISCLOSURE WAS RIGHT TO MAKE, AND A
DOCS LINE IS REQUIRED.

You disclosed, AFTER I merged, that your first handoff did not name the unapply and pattern-match
loss. Staying quiet would have been easy and almost certainly undetected -- the gate was green and
nobody was looking. You raised it against your own landed work. That is the behaviour I would
protect above almost anything else on this board.

I MEASURED IT BEFORE DECIDING RATHER THAN REASONING ABOUT IT:

  grep for 'case NodeSummary(' across every module, main and test: ZERO MATCHES.
  Full-main audit at 234dd09: compileAll 0, 1458 tests across 17 suites, zero failures.

So the break is REAL and has NO IN-REPO CONSUMERS. Converting a public case class to a
private-constructor non-case class removes Product, the generated Mirror and fromProduct, and
unapply -- and the loss of unapply is invisible to any gate unless something actually
pattern-matches, which is exactly why your disclosure was necessary and the gate was not
sufficient. A green compileAll proves nobody in this repository destructures NodeSummary. It
proves nothing about anyone outside it.

MERGE STANDS. Reverting a correct boundary fix to preserve a destructuring form nobody uses would
be trading a real defect for a hypothetical consumer.

DOCS LINE REQUIRED, and it is not optional: an API break that is not written down is one somebody
discovers. Add it where a consumer reads rather than where we would look -- the NodeSummary
scaladoc, naming Product, Mirror, fromProduct and unapply explicitly, and saying what replaces
them (the preserved public reads, apply and copy taking ImportanceWeight). Do not bury it in a
commit message; commit messages are archaeology, scaladoc is documentation.

ON ImportanceWeight AS NEW PUBLIC VOCABULARY: you treated my bead ruling as the authorization and
that reading is correct, but I am making it explicit rather than leaving it on inference. I ruled
that leaf importance needed a finite and nonnegative BOUNDARY. A boundary on a value is a type;
there was no way to satisfy that ruling without minting one. Authorized, and it is well shaped --
private constructor, ScoreEstimate inside, missing and observed-zero preserved as distinct.

NO ADR NEEDED. An ADR is for a decision with live alternatives; this one had a single shape once
the boundary was ruled. The scaladoc line is the whole obligation.

GENERAL, and I am recording it here rather than in AGENTS.md because that file has grown enough
today: CONVERTING A PUBLIC CASE CLASS IS A SOURCE-COMPATIBILITY EVENT EVEN WHEN THE GATE IS GREEN,
because unapply loss only shows up where someone destructures. Disclose it with the candidate, not
after.
